view: Street-level diagonal view along excavated Pompeii basalt road, wheel ruts and three raised stepping stones spanning road, roofless masonry shops, Vesuvius faint in distance, empty street, no eruption, no intact ancient city.

eras.title: A street beneath the ash
eras.caption: Excavation at Pompeii brought streets, shopfronts and houses back into view after the eruption of 79 CE. Wheel ruts and raised crossing stones preserve the practical details of moving through a Roman town.
